newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil flat, buyers monitor IPE futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil flat, buyers monitor IPE futures.

text.p: NWE gas oil was flat with a negative tone as benchmark IPE futures hugged recent low levels and the physical supply situation remained bearish, traders said.
July IPE gas oil was flat at $158.75 a tonne at 1150 GMT having shed $5 on Wednesday.

The heating oil barge market remained in the doldrums with premiums oscillating around the screen flat level. Running refinery was quoted around July IPE -75 cents/flat fob ARA while storage material was some 50 cents below there.
Low sulphur barges were slightly more active with a small barge parcel trading at July +$5 for June delivery and another at July IPE +$4.50 for first half July delivery.
Few traders expected much activity while IPE futures remained weak as buyers held out for the lowest possible benchmark price.
"The minute we see futures turnaround buyers will come back in but in the meantime they'll stay on the sidelines," one trader said.
The cargo market remained under pressure. Russian cargoes were assessed around July -$1.50/-$1.0 fob cif NWE.
Other 0.2 percent material was offered at slightly stronger levels but buyers and sellers remained wide apart.
Low sulphur cargo premiums remained in the July +$4.50/+$5.50 cif NWE range.
